note: Marks are by eye, from grid images (scripts/mark_tool.py grid, check), for alignment only: they are not evidence and locate nothing. top = the tower's or pole's highest point; base = the middle of its foot on the ground, or with base_cut true the point where its axis leaves the frame (or the crop). top_cut true: the top is out of the frame, and the top mark is where the axis leaves it.
alignment: Fixed base line, the height growing by class: every tower's base (or where its axis leaves the frame) sits on y=990 on the centre line x=960 and its top straight above it, at a height set by its class (distribution 680 px, 35 kV and 35-110 kV 720, 330 kV 840, 750 kV 900, the crossing towers 960). Chosen over one fixed top height because the poles are small in the dashcam frames: stretching them to a crossing tower's height would upscale them 3-4x. The heights were raised (from 560/610/690/820/900) so each frame fills more of the canvas; poles that would then need more than about 2.2x upscaling were left out. One similarity transform per frame (shift, uniform scale, rotation).
rules: pixels only resampled (area when shrinking, bicubic otherwise) and cropped; never generated, filled, inpainted or sharpened
black where the moved frame does not cover the canvas
hard cuts; one fade from black at the start
no text, marks or labels drawn; no sound
logos, captions and channel overlays cropped off (crop) or left outside the canvas

frames.class_how: by eye: one long crossarm at the top carrying three phases, an earth-wire peak above, a second short arm below, standing on a caisson in open water; the 750 kV crossing towers are described with their crossbar near the top (126 m, SkyscraperPage no. 23, scene3d/towers.py). That this is the Kakhovka crossing: the uploader's description names the 330 and 750 kV crossings of the Kakhovka reservoir, and the thermal plant's chimneys stand on the far shore behind the line (the NPP's cooling towers come into view in the same pan, 180 s). Base marked where the legs meet the caisson, as for crossing_user_1
frames.why: real footage of the crossing over full water: the 750 kV tower on its caisson, the thermal plant behind
frames.capture_hint: published 29 June 2023 (after the breach) but the reservoir is full, so filmed before 6 June 2023; the date it was filmed is not given
